label: High at D1 after unrewarded a2, at D2 on rare a2->S1; lower as belief favours S1.
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 15 (timing: negative at D1/D2, ~+0.87 at GO). Beyond timing it is raised at D1 after an unrewarded a2 trial (+0.6 to +0.9 residual; a1 trials push it down), raised at D2 when an a2 choice rarely lands in S1 (and lowered when a1 rarely lands in S2), and is graded negatively with the observer belief log-odds that S1 is good across all phases. GO modulation is small (slightly higher after a2). The free fit adds phase-specific belief slopes, an a1-at-D1 offset, the a1->S2 D2 cell and a GO prev_action term (dev 0.71 vs 0.59 short). Observed variables only (action/state at D2 are already seen); no future or model-output terms.

issues: The D2 term only covers rare a2->S1, which the profile puts at +0.92. It leaves out the equally large drop on rare a1->S2 (-0.64; common a1->S1 is +0.04 and common a2->S2 is -0.17). The explanation mentions this drop, but the label and short form do not. A single signed term, (phase == D2) * (state - action) with weight -0.79, covers both rare cells.

The belief term is pooled across all phases and its fitted weight is small (-0.048). Once the state-action term is in, belief adds little at D2: (phase == D2) * belief_lo as the third term scores only 0.537 on test. Restricting belief to D1 and GO, (phase != D2) * belief_lo, scores 0.636.

Test R^2 beyond timing: recorded short form 0.577; with (state - action) at D2 and pooled belief 0.606; with (state - action) and D1-only belief 0.629; with (state - action) and (phase != D2) * belief_lo 0.636.

Systematic misses remain under the improved form. D1 after a1 S2 r is over-predicted by -0.32 and D2 after a2 S2 u by -0.31. D2 after a1 S1 r is under-predicted by +0.18. The worst windows are long a1-rewarded streaks: there the D2 a1->S1 value is about +0.6 to +0.75 against a prediction of about -0.23 to -0.5. No observed term fixes this; adding belief x state or a lagged reward at D2 gains less than 0.002.
The D1 claim checks out. Residual is +0.61 to +0.93 after an unrewarded a2 trial, about 0 after a rewarded a2 trial, and -0.2 to -0.4 after any a1 trial. GO effects are small, as claimed.
